limitations: This is source and CPU contract review, not launch permission or completed European numerical qualification.
The stochastic CPU test checks restoration machinery using synthetic gradients; it does not reproduce scientific European training or validate CUDA RNG execution.
Real qualification, current ROOT peer/resource admission, exact source-review hashes and actual terminal wait/family absence remain required by the reviewed entry point.
A progress snapshot is bounded evidence of completed updates, not authority to resume a live process or select an unverified partial checkpoint.
No TEST prediction, independent-VAL accuracy, scientific improvement, stable throughput or sustained useful GPU utilization claim is established.
Runtime output/RSS checks are finite guards, not a filesystem quota or proof of an unmeasured future peak.
source_findings: driver_v3 delegates observed preparation, complete TRAIN target joins, cohort model, FP32 complete-parent numerical step and original AdamW settings to unchanged reviewed driver_v2. Original3x200Mb TRAIN parents,50000 rows,30 passes and90 updates remain fixed.

A private random.Random(101+epoch) reproduces the original three-parent permutation for every epoch. The exact next-parent cursor and completed update count cap continuation at90; restore at90 performs no new update.

Resume payload binds reviewed source manifests, protocol, original sampling plan, all-parent observation barrier, settings, class order, epoch and cursor. All49 model tensors, all49 Adam states and their147 tensors are validated for exact structures/shapes/settings/counters and finite FP32 values before restore.

Python, NumPy MT19937, Torch CPU and the single CUDA device RNG byte state are captured and restored. All original observed-parent seals are re-established before TRAIN target access, and old/new barrier values must match.

Every completed update gets an immutable bounded resume checkpoint. Six original epoch checkpoints remain fixed at5,10,15,20,25,30, with final epoch30 selection. No validation-driven or TEST-driven selection is added.

Previous update and epoch-checkpoint refs are authenticated before continuation; inherited progress cannot silently replace an epoch checkpoint. Exact previous ROOT request/launch/actual-wait identity and current family absence are required even after an interrupted nonzero exit.

Qualification gate retains successful original200Mb TRAIN qualification, all49 gradient/parameter comparisons,147 Adam tensors, zero argmax changes, original tolerances and actual wait0/family absence. The failed European predecessor cannot satisfy this gate.

Wrapper binds exact guardian argv, PID generations, peer list, UUID and resource allowances. CPU preparation precedes late shared physical GPU lease; source/qualification/resume gates are rechecked at acquisition.

Plaintext guardian adaptation preserves existing worker protections and process-family cleanup; its changes are a narrow fresh ROOT run directory restriction and explicit2GiB whole-run output allowance. Existing jobs are not changed.

Per-checkpoint8MiB limit,768MiB resume writer, original64MiB scientific writer and whole-run2GiB guard are compatible. Checkpoint bytes and directory entries are fsynced. Progress and wrapper metadata are bounded and source-bound.
